_comment: Conformance benchmark gate. Compares a run against what a healthy run looks like and fails the build on anything unexpected. Rates are computed over modules that produced a verdict, so expected failures, documented skips and wallet handoffs never move the pass rate.

_model.passRate: passed / (passed + failed - toleratedFailures). Tolerated = modules listed in expected-failures.json.
_model.conditionSuccessRate: SUCCESS / (SUCCESS + WARNING + FAILURE) over individual conformance conditions, from api/log/{id}.
_model.baseline: Set baselineFile (or pass --baseline) to a stored results.json and failOnRegression to gate on regressions against it.
